fields.summary: Place an order with a customer name and item
fields.description:
As a customer, I want to place an order with my name and an item so that the order is stored and I can see it on the list.

Acceptance:
- Submitting a customer name and item creates an order and shows it on the page.
- POST /api/orders with customer and item returns 201.
- Missing customer returns 400.
- The created order can be fetched by id.
